decisions.reason: After a year of learning from overlapping express offers, management is likely to fold the narrower fifteen-day program into the stronger express range and reallocate resources, since the underlying know-how can be absorbed elsewhere in the portfolio.

As an approved fire-resistant exterior door embedded in the firm's modular safety-door knowledge base, it fits existing R&D, certification, and customer-compliance capabilities too well to withdraw absent clear market weakness.

The broader express line for doors and gates uses the firm's established production and service routines and, after the withdrawal of the 72-hour variant, is the scalable express format most worth refining rather than dropping.
Fire and smoke protection remains a core adjacent field where the firm's technical and regulatory expertise supports continued improvement and commercialization, so withdrawal is unlikely.
